summary: Constructive generalized quantifiers after Sundholm 1989, grafted onto Ranta's Sigma/Pi idiom. A counting layer over an enumerated CN (most/some/every/no/exactly-half by filter-length); the entailment square (every=>most on nonempty domains, most=>some, no=>not-most, contrariety of most(B) and most(not-B)); conservativity in Barwise-Cooper format and right upward monotonicity; Sundholm's proof-object 'most' (formula (23): a majority-sized injective witness list, each element carried with its proof) proved equivalent to the counting truth-condition via pigeonhole, with bridges every(Pi) => most_wit => some(Sigma); countermodels: some without most, failure of left upward monotonicity for most (with some's left-monotonicity as contrast), the separation showing every/some/no verdicts do not determine most, non-monotonicity of exactly-half, and Sundholm's donkey contrast (26): the conditional reading of 'most men who own a donkey beat it' holds while no owner beats his donkey.

sources.citation: Sundholm, G. (1989). Constructive Generalized Quantifiers. Synthese 79(1): 1-12.

definitions_mapped.coq: most_wit = { w : list A & NoDup w * incl w dom * (2*|w| > |dom|) * (forall x, In x w -> B x) }
definitions_mapped.source: S89 (23) pp. 7-8: exists k >= [p(a)/2]+1, injection f : M(k) -> A, phi at every image point
definitions_mapped.note: NoDup+incl list = image of the injection from M(k); 2k > n <-> k >= [n/2]+1 on nat

definitions_mapped.source: S89 p. 7 (VIII): 'more than half', presupposition Finite(A)
definitions_mapped.note: Finite(A) as bijection with M(k) is replaced by carrying the enumeration itself as a Section Variable (artifact iii); NoDup enters per-theorem where the cardinal matters

definitions_mapped.source: S89 (24)-(26) pp. 8-9: Most over the Sigma-type of owner-proof pairs, not the conditional reading
definitions_mapped.note: pair counting per p. 9 ('ordered pairs', two donkeys = counted twice); the squashed subset-type alternative is recorded as not formalized

definitions_mapped.source: BC81 C1 conservativity, stated in the enumerated setting
definitions_mapped.note: near-definitional here because counting already happens inside the restrictor - which is itself the type-theoretic explanation of conservativity

evidence: most_wit is formula (23) transposed: injective majority-sized witness family with per-element proofs; the equivalence with counting is proved, not assumed.
The donkey contrast is Sundholm's own scenario compiled: the wrong reading verified true, the right reading verified false, no owner beats.
All 19 audited theorems closed under the global context under Coq 8.20.1.
simplifications: Finite(A) (S89 (14), bijection with canonical M(k)) becomes an enumeration list carried as a Section Variable; NoDup is a per-theorem hypothesis
counting layer uses decidable predicates A -> bool (artifact ii); the Type-level layer takes B : A -> Type undecided
omissions: infinite-domain quantifiers INF (17), COUNT (18), Uc (19), More (20), At-least (21), Almost-all (22): need injections from N or the second number class
FIN (16): trivializes on enumerated domains (every predicate finite)
the squashed subset-type counting alternative (p. 9, Nordstrom et al. subset type)
genuine BC81 C13 undefinability of most (research-grade metatheorem); most_separates is its honest finite fragment
sugaring of 'most' into Ranta.v's fragment grammar (would touch the pinned file)
additions: exactly-half as the non-monotone specimen (not in S89)
conservativity/monotonicity checklist from BC81 stated in the enumerated setting
the explicit equivalence most_wit <-> most_c (S89 gives the definition; the pigeonhole equivalence with filter-counting is ours)

determination_rationale: Sundholm's definition (23) is native type theory and transposes almost verbatim; the one substantive encoding decision is replacing Finite(A)-via-bijection with a carried enumeration, documented as artifact iii and motivated by keeping every countermodel vm-computable.

artifact_classes.description: counting layer in Prop (nat comparisons), proof-object layer in Type; they meet in most_wit_counts/most_counts_wit
decidable predicates at the counting layer make countermodels computable
enumeration as a bare list Variable; NoDup only where the cardinal matters
zero axioms/Parameters; eq_dec enters as a per-section Hypothesis for conservativity only

notes: Extension file of the MTT+Ranta pair: Sundholm-style proportional quantification in Ranta's idiom, motivated by the verifier episode where models correctly refused to state 'most' over an abstract CN without counting structure. The hidden premise is now a displayed Section Variable. The scan of S89 must be copied from ~/Downloads/view.pdf to papers/foundations/Sundholm_1989_ConstructiveGeneralizedQuantifiers.pdf. Counts include the 11 helper lemmas (list arithmetic); the audited theorem list is the 19 Theorems with Print Assumptions.
